UP students protest for basic amenities, administration concedes

In Fatehpur, Uttar Pradesh, students from a government inter college protested outside the school over issues of electricity and water. The students, described as 'Gen Alpha', took to the streets to demand basic facilities. Following the demonstration, the administration reportedly agreed to their demands.
